propositions: At search exhaustion, bounded fallback evidence incorrectly banks met=false (refutation) instead of met=false + evidence_sufficient:false (absence-of-evidence), producing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not reached within the search window.

The banking write path must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) by introducing an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met:false, written only by the framework's bounded fallback, never by model-facing tools.

All verdict consumers (schema, recovery, rendering, sidecars, close gate) must validate and preserve the tri-state marker, re-stamping from the authoritative bank source during merge, and emit insufficient-evidence remediation text distinct from unmet-criteria guidance.

The audit ticket page consumer was missing from the enumerated graph, using shape-based PASS/FAIL discrimination that broke when FAIL payloads gained criteria; it must key on sidecar verdict directly to render failure findings.

Marker preservation on harvest overwrite ensures fallback-banked insufficient entries survive markerless successor re-harvest, while genuine refutations (bare met=false) replace prior entries without losing the marker distinction.
